player_0.content: New plan: I got stuck in a loop of following the chain of statements without considering the initial statements about the truthfulness of the individuals. What is worse, I didn't even use the information from the initial statements to my advantage. Next time, I will start by analyzing the initial statements and use them to infer the truthfulness of the individuals involved in the chain of statements. For example, if I know that Raymond lies, I will not trust any statement made by Raymond or by someone who says Raymond tells the truth. I will also pay closer attention to the statements that contradict each other and use that information to make a more informed decision.
